Uses same-tab handoffs, preserves the current time range for dashboard-to-dashboard links, resets unsupported dashboard-specific scope where needed, and exposes Explore Logs plus an Explore Traces adjunct that is available only for traced runs with a safe bounded 150m Tempo handoff.

links.title: 3. Provider Health
links.tooltip: Context mapping: provider=unknown, pipeline_context=$pipeline, adapter=unknown. Visible workflow/pipeline/run_type are preserved; provider remains fail-closed when unknown.

links.title: 5. Workflow
links.tooltip: Preserves selected scope and time range.

links.title: Silver Reject Explorer
links.tooltip: Cross-scope handoff: bounded pipeline/run_type explorer scope. Reset scope: Silver Reject Explorer owns record-level filters and forensic narrowing. Opens in the same tab.

links.title: Explore Logs
links.tooltip: Tracing-profile dependency: opens Logs Drilldown in the same tab with safe {job="bioetl"} baseline. Reset scope: dashboard selectors are not pre-applied; preserve the time range and refine pipeline/run_type inside Explore. Zero lines can legitimately mean Loki shipping is disabled, no BioETL log streams were shipped in range, or the baseline query still needs refinement inside Explore.

links.title: Explore Traces
links.tooltip: Tracing-profile dependency: available only for traced runs. Enable tracing with --tracing or BIOETL_OBSERVABILITY__TRACING_ENABLED=true. Reset scope: opens Traces Drilldown in the same tab with bounded pipeline/run_type TraceQL scope. NoOpTracing or tracing-off runs can legitimately be empty, so treat this as adjunct evidence rather than first-screen proof.

panels.title: Provenance
panels.description: Unified context/provenance banner for 4. Data Quality. Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Workflow is context/evidence unless documented otherwise; run_id is local control-plane identity context only.

options.content: Is Data Quality currently OK/WARN/CRIT and what should be inspected first?

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Primary compact Data Quality verdict for the selected pipeline scope. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Workflow is context/evidence only; run_id is local control-plane identity context and does not filter Prometheus. Monitor DQ Current Status below is an expanded first-screen mirror of this same current-status recording rule, not an independent second verdict.

panels.title: ID
panels.description: Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels.

panels.title: Processed Records
panels.description: Current Bronze/Silver/Gold stage/outcome accounting evidence for the shared pipeline/run_type context. Uses bounded stage/outcome accounting recording rules; missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage.
Selected-range evidence only. This panel no longer drives current DQ status; use Monitor DQ Current Status for incident state.

dataLinks.title: Open Logs in Loki Explore (tracing profile)
Open Traces in Tempo Explore (tracing profile)
Open Logs (Loki, contextual scope marker, tracing)

panels.title: Track Range Evidence: Bronze -> Silver -> Gold

panels.description: Expanded mirror of the compact Status verdict, placed beside DQ threshold and reason panels for first-screen triage. Uses the same current-status recording rule as Status: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT; null=UNKNOWN; it is not an independent second signal. Current status is a pipeline-wide 15m snapshot from canonical recording rules, not selected-range evidence. Use the threshold and reason panels to explain the verdict.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Current Status

panels.description: Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT; null=UNKNOWN. Threshold state stays bounded: hard-fail reasons map to CRIT, warning-only reasons map to WARN, and explicit current OK stays OK. Disabled or noop DQ monitoring is treated as a warning-state reason, not unconditional green. Current threshold state is pipeline-wide; use selected-range panels below for scoped evidence.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Threshold State

panels.description: Current DQ reasons table with severity and action_target. Soft threshold/quarantine map to WARN; hard validation/anomaly/silver validation map to CRIT. A pipeline can be CRIT here even when filtered_out is zero because quarantine and silver validation are separate blocker paths. Empty table means no active DQ reasons are currently above zero for the selected pipeline snapshot.
panels.title: Inspect DQ Current Reasons
Review: First Action

options.content: CRIT: inspect DQ reasons first; if filtered_out=0, check Quarantined, Silver Validation Failures, and Blocked Share before assuming the incident is a reject-path issue. WARN: open Silver Reject Explorer. Scope: status above is pipeline-wide; $run_type and stage filters shape only selected-range evidence below. invalid_record_policy visibility absent = UNKNOWN.

panels.description: Operator CTA for first-pass DQ triage. It explains what to do for CRIT versus WARN states, clarifies that the answer row above is pipeline-wide current state while run_type and stage mainly shape selected-range evidence, and explicitly distinguishes reject-path evidence from quarantine/validation blockers when filtered_out remains zero.

Threshold semantics: keep no-data as UNKNOWN (not score 0); warnings indicate drift, hard-fail signals block data promotion. Next action: if hard-fail>0 open reject/quarantine diagnostics; if warning-only, review trend and top reject causes. Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor: Data Quality Score (Volume-weighted)

panels.description: Selected-range Bronze denominator for DQ triage. 0 means no Bronze records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove DQ metrics are missing. Compare with Gold output and blocked-share panels below.
panels.title: Track: Source Records in Range (Bronze)

panels.description: Selected-range Gold output count for DQ deliverability triage. 0 means no Gold records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove the current DQ verdict is OK or UNKNOWN. Compare with Bronze denominator, blocked-share, and the shared Processed Records table before interpreting data loss.
panels.title: Track: Clean Records in Range (Gold)
Monitor: Worst-Entity DQ Score
panels.description: Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.

Selected-range quarantine count. Non-zero means records were withheld from normal promotion and require quarantine triage even when Silver filter rejects remain zero; 0 means no quarantined records were reported in the selected window.
panels.title: Track: Records Quarantined in Range

panels.description: Selected-range count of Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion in the active window, and this can drive current CRIT even when filtered_out stays zero. Correlate with current DQ reasons and quarantine evidence before replay.
panels.title: Track: Silver Validation Failures in Range

panels.description: Current worst freshness lag in seconds for the selected pipeline. Large values indicate stale data even if no DQ hard-fail is active; compare with latest-success timestamp to distinguish stale entities from total pipeline inactivity.
panels.title: Monitor: Worst Data Freshness Lag (seconds)

panels.description: Selected-range deliverability impact. Numerator = Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records; denominator = Bronze input for the same pipeline/run_type window. 0 means no blocked records were observed in the selected window, not that DQ metrics are globally healthy. A value of 100% is possible with filtered_out=0 when all records were quarantined instead of rejected by filters.

targets.expr: (((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(max_over_time(bioetl_dq_records_quarantined_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: Monitor: DQ Impact on Deliverability (Blocked Share)

panels.description: Latest successful data timestamp for the selected pipeline scope. This is current freshness context and compact supporting evidence rather than a first-answer verdict or selected-range proof. UNKNOWN means no freshness proof is available now; next action: inspect DQ Current Reasons and the DQ investigation runbook before treating stale or blank values as healthy.
panels.title: Review: Latest Successful Data Timestamp
Track: Silver Filter Rejects in Range
panels.description: Selected-range Silver reject count from the filtered_out path only. A zero here does not refute current CRIT because quarantine and Silver validation blockers are separate paths; use first-screen DQ reasons and the quarantine/validation panels before assuming the incident is filter-driven.
Silver reject reconciliation signal. Non-zero means the stage-total filtered_out counter diverges from the bounded Silver reject breakdown metric over the selected range.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Filter Reject Accounting Mismatch

panels.description: Selected-range pipeline breakdown of Silver filter rejects. Use it to see which selected pipeline values dominate filtered_out volume before drilling into reason_code or field breakdowns.

targets.expr: sum by (pipeline) (max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "pipeline", "no_events", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Silver Filter Rejects by Pipeline

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (reason_code) (increase(bioetl_silver_filter_rejections_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "reason_code", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Reasons (Pareto)
panels.description: Pareto ranking of bounded Silver reject reasons across the selected range. Use the top-level Silver Reject Explorer handoff to investigate the selected pipeline/run_type in record-level detail and then narrow by reason_code inside the explorer.

Bounded schema-field summary for the selected range. Use the top-level Silver Reject Explorer handoff to investigate the selected pipeline/run_type in record-level detail and then narrow by field inside the explorer.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (field) (increase(bioetl_silver_filter_rejections_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "field", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Fields

panels.description: Selected-range quarantine distribution by error type. 0/none means no quarantined records were observed in the active window; use this to decide whether triage belongs in quarantine, schema validation, or provider drift.
panels.title: Inspect: Quarantine by Error Type

panels.description: Selected-range anomaly counts by severity and anomaly type. WARN-only anomalies indicate drift; CRIT anomalies are blocking and should be correlated with current DQ reasons before replay or promotion.
panels.title: Track: Anomalies Detected

panels.description: Selected-range p95 duration of DQ checks. This is a diagnostics/performance surface, not a quality outcome; use it when DQ checks themselves look slow or noisy during an incident. Samples exist only when the runtime emitted bioetl_dq_check_duration_ms, which requires an active DQ monitor path rather than disabled/noop monitoring. No data means no DQ duration samples were observed in range or DQ timing telemetry is absent; it is not equivalent to fast checks.
panels.title: Track: DQ Check Duration (p95)

panels.description: Selected-range count of canonical Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion and should be correlated with current DQ reasons and reject/quarantine evidence.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Validation Failures

panels.description: Selected-range lineage/control-plane correlation signal. Non-zero means traceability metadata was incomplete and replay/readiness may need Control Plane follow-up; this panel does not replace Control Plane diagnostics.
panels.title: Monitor: Lineage Refs Missing

panels.description: Quality score trend over selected time range. Kept separate from operational gating indicators. Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Track: Data Quality Score Trend (Volume-weighted)

panels.description: Selected-range trend of deliverability impact. Numerator = Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records; denominator = Bronze input for the same pipeline/run_type window. Use sustained elevation as DQ pressure evidence and sudden spikes as incident evidence.

targets.expr: (((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(max_over_time(bioetl_dq_records_quarantined_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: Track: DQ Impact on Deliverability Trend (Blocked Share %)

panels.description: Operator note that redirects aggregate control-plane symptoms to the Control Plane dashboard and runbook surfaces; no datasource query is expected.

options.content:
### Control-plane aggregates available
- Open `0. Control Plane` for aggregated manifest writes, ledger appends, checkpoint compatibility outcomes, and control-plane read failures.
- Use the `Observability Checklist (runbook)` dashboard link when `BioETLControlPlaneReadFailureRate` or related aggregate signals require operator follow-up.
